customer_acme_co: Hey team — we're seeing tool calls fail when our CI pastes a bash heredoc into the tool args. Error 400: 'toolcall payload invalid JSON'.

alex_cs: Thanks, can you paste the exact request payload and the cURL you used? Short repro helps.

customer_acme_co: Here's the cURL from our CI (sanitized):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{
  "model": "open-q-3b",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"call_tool"}],
  "tool_call": {"name":"process_invoice","args":"<<'PAYLOAD'\n{\n\t\"invoice_id\": \"INV-1234\",\n\t\"notes\": \"pasted\\tline with a tab\",\n}\nPAYLOAD\n"}
}'
```

dev_jordan: I think the heredoc is being inserted verbatim into a JSON string and includes a trailing comma and a literal tab char. The parser probably chokes on the unescaped tab and trailing comma inside the JSON string literal.

support-bot: Error returned from API: 400 Bad Request {"error":"Invalid tool args JSON","detail":"JSON parse error at offset 58: invalid control character"} 

alex_cs: Can you repro locally with the same command and attach the raw request body we receive (we log request bodies for support)? Also send the request_id from response headers.

customer_acme_co: Repro attached. request_id=r_abc123. Raw body (from our client) below — note the tab is a real TAB, not \t:

```json
{\"model\":\"open-q-3b\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"call_tool\"}],\"tool_call\":{\"name\":\"process_invoice\",\"args\":\"<<'PAYLOAD'\\n{\\n\t\"invoice_id\": \"INV-1234\",\\n\t\"notes\": \"pasted	line with a tab\",\\n}\\nPAYLOAD\\n\"}}\n```

eng_lucy: Thanks — reproducer looks good. Short-term workaround: remove the heredoc and pass a properly escaped JSON string or encode the args as base64. Example:

```bash
--args-raw "{\"invoice_id\":\"INV-1234\",\"notes\":\"pasted\\tline with a tab\"}"
# or
--args-b64 $(echo -n '{"invoice_id":"INV-1234","notes":"pasted	line with a tab"}' | base64)
```

dev_jordan: We'll add a fix to the parser to reject unescaped control chars more clearly and strip benign leading/trailing newlines from heredocs. Creating ENG issue.

alex_cs: Escalating to eng-runtime; pinging @eng-runtime. Ticket SUP-2026-245 opened. ETA initial investigation 24h. :hourglass:

customer_acme_co: Thanks — will try the base64 workaround and report back. Appreciate the quick triage. :pray:

alex_cs: Noted. I'll update once eng posts a patch. Closing loop when you confirm.
